snippet.title: Chess but it's an autobattler - Chessire
snippet.description:
A roguelike tactical auto battler where you build an army of chess pieces infused with stats and magical abilities.

Play for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2629630?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/DFj4RxfBV9
